candidates.why: Photos 3-4 show a phone with individual circular camera lenses (Contour Cut design with separate rings per lens) characteristic of the Galaxy S22 Ultra. The flat top/bottom edges visible in the side profile (photo 5) are also consistent with S22 Ultra. The S Pen slot area and squared-off design match S22 Ultra rather than S23 Ultra.

Seller claims S23 Ultra, but the individual separated camera lens rings visible in photo 3 do not match the S23 Ultra's larger unified camera rings. Side profile in photo 5 shows flat edges more consistent with S22 Ultra.
Standard S22 has a vertical camera bump, not individual rings. Ruled out by photos.
S21 Ultra has a different camera housing (P-shaped contour cut), not separate rings. Ruled out.
S24 Ultra has a flat back with unified camera rings, not the separated design shown. Ruled out.

evidence_used: Separate individual camera lens rings in photo 3 (Contour Cut design)
Squared-off top/bottom edges visible in side profile photo 5
Large form factor consistent with Ultra model
Front display with centered punch-hole camera in photo 6
No visible S Pen in photos but slot location consistent with Ultra
